rows.en:
Every nerve he had was focused on the nape of his neck.
A sensation that was cold, and hot, and ticklish all at once.
If this was what it meant to have your soul eaten, he found himself thinking it might not be so bad after all..........you see.
"The souls of people with rich imaginations really are delicious.
I'll eat you with loving care..."
She murmured that with Higashiyama's neck held in her mouth.
Hearing it, Higashiyama felt strangely fulfilled.
And just like that... he died.{p}

"...Do you understand now?
Nothing good ever comes of inventing an imaginary lover."
Iwashita said that, and smiled.
"But I do understand wanting a lover.
If you're so inclined, {a}, I wouldn't mind becoming yours..."{p}
She laid one hand over mine.

Seeing me like that, Iwashita let out a low chuckle.
"Oh, I'm sorry.
So you didn't know a girl's body heat either... Silly me, repeating her mistake."
A tiny whisper that probably no one but me could hear.
Iwashita's eyes glinted coldly.
But the next instant...{p}
"...Heh heh, and that's the end of my story.

{a}, do think over that matter of making me your lover."
Iwashita laughed and took her seat.
But I couldn't move for a while.
Was that just one of Iwashita's jokes?
Then what about that hand, cold as ice★
I didn't know.
It all felt like a sick joke.
But if Iwashita really had her sights set on me...
Iwashita was gazing at me meaningfully.
Holding down the panic rising in me, I turned to face the last of them.{p}

"...Do you remember me?"
That's what she asked him.
But Higashiyama hadn't the faintest idea what she meant.
So he told her so, honestly.
"I see..."
She hung her head sadly.
Feeling he'd done something wrong, Higashiyama peered into her face.
"Sorry.
If we've met before, won't you tell me?"
"...You really don't remember?"
As she said it, there was something eerie about her face.{p}

Maybe it was only because the sunset was far too red.
"When you talked about your girlfriend, was that just a coincidence?
I thought you were describing me."
"What are you talking about?
Sure, you match exactly what I said I wanted in a girlfriend, but..."
Higashiyama flinched.
He'd started to think she might be a little dangerous.
So, before he could stop himself, he said it.
"To tell you the truth, I don't have a girlfriend.
Everything I said before was just made up.
So you looking like her is just a coincidence too!"
Her expression changed in a flash.{p}

"A coincidence?
So you didn't remember me after all★"
Her arms shot out and clamped around Higashiyama's neck.
"How cruel... how cruel of you.
To forget all about me☆"
She kept saying it over and over as she squeezed Higashiyama's neck tighter and tighter.
That was no girl's strength.
On the verge of blacking out, Higashiyama braced himself to die.
Just then, she suddenly loosened her grip.
Higashiyama collapsed to the ground.{p}

"You really did forget me, didn't you..."
She said it sadly.{p}

Then she turned her back and started to walk out of the park.
That back looked familiar to Higashiyama.

The girl he used to play with all the time when he was little...
"It's Iku-chan!"{p}
At Higashiyama's voice, she whirled around with a start.

"You remember me, Higashiyama!"
Yes, when they were small, she was a girl who lived in his neighborhood.
"I'm sorry... I thought the girlfriend you talked about was me.
When I found out it wasn't, I just lost my temper..."
"No, I'm the one who should be sorry.
How could I ever have forgotten you?"
Higashiyama apologized, forgetting she'd just been strangling him.
When he thought about it, he must have loved her back then.
That's why, even after he forgot her, she stayed in his mind as his 'ideal girlfriend.'
When he told her so, she smiled bashfully, I'm told.{p}

Higashiyama called after her, but she didn't turn around, he said.
She went straight out of the park and..........{p}

And then, you see.
Right before Higashiyama's eyes, she vanished into thin air.{p}

Higashiyama said it felt like being struck over the head.
Why she had disappeared from the neighborhood.
Why he had forgotten her.
Why she'd had that kind of strength.
...In that instant, he remembered everything.
He understood it all.{p}

What do I mean?
...She had died more than ten years before.
In a traffic accident.
Soon after that, her family moved away.
Little Higashiyama couldn't understand his friend's death.
He would never see his dear friend again...
The shock was too much for a small child, so he forgot.
They say that when people suffer emotional damage that's too great to bear, they sometimes forget it entirely.
I suppose it's a defense to keep the mind from breaking.
Higashiyama.......... is actually my older cousin, and that's what he told me.

...Well, that's how it was.
Now you understand why I said imaginary lovers are a bad idea, don't you?{p}

'Imaginary' is only what you think. The truth may be otherwise.
If that lover of yours suddenly appeared, and you acted the way Higashiyama did...
There's no guarantee they'd be a gentle ghost who changes their mind halfway, like Higashiyama's 'Iku-chan.'
If you understand, you'd better stop telling lies like that.
...My story is over.
Next, at last, comes the sixth story.{p}

My, why is that?
I may be older, but it's not as if I'm ten or twenty years older than you.
I was only born a year or two before you, that's all.{p}Do you still dislike older women, even so?
I still dislike them
I don't dislike them
Scream, "Stop it already!"

...Once upon a time, a new first-year student came to this school.
He didn't stand out much, but he was a gentle-looking boy.
There was a girl who fell in love with him.
She was an upperclassman.
But love is free, isn't it?
She worked up her courage and decided to confess to him.{p}

But I suppose she couldn't bring herself to do it out of the blue.
She asked the boy,
"Do you dislike older women?"
..........just like that.{p}What do you think he answered?
He likes older women
He dislikes older women
Scream, "Stop it already!"

"Liar."
Iwashita snapped.
Her eyes were glinting strangely.
"You have to answer honestly.
It's 'dislike,' isn't it?
The answer was 'dislike,' wasn't it?"
What?
Was she talking about my answer a moment ago?
I had no idea what was going on.
But overwhelmed by Iwashita's intensity, I found myself nodding.{p}

"...Yes, that's right. That's how it should be."
Iwashita went on with her story, looking satisfied.{p}

Yes, he answered that he disliked them.
Did her feelings not get through to him?
...No, that can't be.
After all, she was always watching him.
With burning eyes.
If he'd noticed even once, he surely would have known how she felt.
And yet he said he disliked them.
Which means he rejected her, doesn't it?
She was hurt.
She truly loved him.
And she began to hate him just as much as she had loved him...{p}

"W-Wait... wait a minute!"
I hurriedly cut in.
Things were taking a strange turn.
Iwashita was staring straight at me.
She said it was something from long ago, but wasn't it really her own story?
In that case, the boy who hurt her was me★
But Iwashita raised a hand.
She stopped me before I could speak.
"...My story isn't over yet.
If you have something to say, save it until I've finished."
An icy voice.
Goosebumps rose all over my skin.
Once I couldn't say a word, Iwashita began talking again.{p}

...The girl decided to make him suffer with a charm.
And it worked.
Right before her eyes, he complained of a terrible headache.
Apparently it was a fierce pain, as if his skull were being smashed open.{p}

Throb.
My head ached.
At the same time, a chill shot down my spine.
The timing with Iwashita's story was just too perfect.
But it had to be my imagination.
I couldn't believe a thing like this could give me a headache.
I told myself that, desperately.

Meanwhile, the headache grew worse and worse.
Iwashita, as if she hadn't noticed the state I was in, went on with her story as though nothing were wrong.{p}

...His headache grew worse.
In the end, it was so bad he couldn't even stand.
He writhed in agony in front of her.
But seeing that, her feelings changed.
Seeing the one she loved suffering, she felt sorry for him.
She ran to him and lifted the charm.{p}

But soon after that, he went and got himself a girlfriend.
A cute girl in his class.
He forgot all about the dead girl.
...She was furious.{p}
One day, the boy was found dead.

Apparently he had beaten his own head against a concrete wall, over and over.
They say the wall and the floor were dyed red all over.{p}

Ever since then, her ghost has haunted this school.
Normally she's a harmless ghost who does nothing.
But whenever a girl is turned down by a younger boy, she comes to her.
She takes revenge in that girl's place.
They say she works that same charm and makes the boy suffer...{p}

What's the matter, {a}?
You look like you're in pain.{p}

The headache was getting worse and worse.
I couldn't hold myself up anymore.
I slumped over the desk, and Iwashita put her arms around my shoulders.

"Does it hurt?
Your head hurts, doesn't it... So this story was true after all."{p}

Quietly, as if singing, Iwashita kept talking.
But her words no longer reached me.
My head felt like it would split open.
"Poor thing... But I don't want to die.
I'm not going to protect you.
You turned me down too, so we're even, aren't we..."{p}

Iwashita's voice grew distant.
Was I just going to die like this?
What did I ever do...
Unable to voice that question, I was swallowed up by a chaotic whirlpool of consciousness...{p}

Oh, you'd better not.
Someone your own age? You're bound to fight all the time.
Even between lovers, one of them has to have the upper hand.
The one who leads, and the one who follows.
The strong and the weak.
It always works out better that way.
Besides, I think someone older suits you better, {a}... heh heh.{p}

My, how dull.
You don't understand a girl's romantic dreams, do you?
Love at first sight really does exist.
You might call it souls calling out to each other.
That feeling that this person and I are surely going to be lovers..........do you really not understand it?{p}

Iwashita turned her face away.
I panicked.
We'd made it all the way to the fifth story, and now it was going to end over something like this.
"Please don't be like that. I'm begging you."
As I bowed my head, Iwashita turned back to me.{p}

But the others' cold stares pierced me.
They all looked as if to say it would be my fault if the seven wonders weren't completed.
I gave in to that silent pressure.
"..........Okay."{p}

I see... Well, I can't blame you.
Then for now, just listen to my story.
As I talk, I think you'll come to understand my personality, my habits, and so on.
When I've finished, I'll ask you again.
By then, decide whether you'll make me your lover.{p}

I don't like being stared at, but I'll make a special exception for you alone, {a}.
What I'm about to tell you is a story of lovers who loved each other.{p}

You're surprisingly cute, {a}.
Exchanging letters - just like a schoolgirl from ages ago.
Oh, I'm not saying it's a bad thing.
That's right, things that are hard to say are sometimes easier to get across in writing, aren't they?{p}

That's what the two of them did, too.
One letter a day, always dropped into the same mailbox.
{a}, do you know how a girl feels at a time like that?
Please let it reach him soon.
Please let a good reply come.
She slips the letter in with such care, as if saying a prayer.
Yaguchi sent her letters with those same wishes, too.
She'd even give the mailbox a little pat-pat, as a good-luck charm.
But it would have been better if she hadn't done that.
Because..........
{a}, do you know about tsukumogami?
They say that a tool comes to hold a soul once a great many years have passed since it was made.{p}

Heh heh, do you see what I'm getting at?
That's right, the mailbox Yaguchi used was a tsukumogami.{p}

...What are you laughing at?
You don't believe what I'm saying?
Or is a living mailbox just too silly?
But it's true.{p}

Well, it seems that mailbox fell in love with Yaguchi.
But Yaguchi had a boyfriend, Date, as you know.
After much thought, it decided to hide Yaguchi's letters.
Naturally, none of them reached Date.{p}

Date pressed Yaguchi about it.
"Why haven't you written me lately?"
Yaguchi was surprised.
After all, she'd been sending them every single day.
"I have been sending them.
Haven't they arrived?"
That surprised Date, too.
He knew better than anyone that Yaguchi wasn't the type to tell that kind of lie.{p}
It looked like a perfectly ordinary mailbox.{p}What do you think the two of them did?
Yaguchi put her hand in the mailbox
Date put his hand in the mailbox
Scream, "Stop it already!"

"Let me check inside."
With that, Yaguchi slipped her hand into the mailbox.{p}

"There doesn't seem to be anything..."
She said that and went to pull her hand out, and then...
"I-It... It won't come out★"
That's right. Her hand was stuck.
Even though the mailbox slot was bigger than her hand.
Yaguchi was on the verge of tears.
"Yaguchi!"
Date pulled on her, but she wouldn't budge at all.{p}

At Date's frantic pleading, the mailbox was opened.
But there was nothing inside except ordinary mail.
In the end, it seems Yaguchi was treated as a runaway.
I hear Date was questioned pretty harshly too, but even if he told the truth, there was no way anyone would believe him.{p}

But don't forget this.
You trampled on a girl's feelings.
That is a sin that deserves death.
Heh heh... Well then, on to the sixth story.{p}

"Let me take a look."
With that, Date shoved his hand into the mailbox.{p}

She looked, and the mailbox's slot had clamped tightly shut.
As if the mailbox had closed its mouth.
Then hot blood ran down Date's arm.
Yaguchi frantically grabbed hold of him.
But it was too late.{p}

There was a dull sound, like something snapping, and his arm was bitten clean off.
As Date rolled around on the ground, the mailbox seemed to look down on him in triumph, they say.{p}

The incident was treated as a simple accident.
Ridiculous, isn't it?
Not long after that, Date's family moved away.
Then Yaguchi's family did too.
They must not have been able to bear all the people spreading stories about them, true or not.{p}

...Come to think of it, that mailbox is right on the way to school, you know.
There's just one thing I don't understand.
That arm that was bitten off... they say when they opened the mailbox, it wasn't inside.
Then where on earth did it disappear to?
Another dimension, I wonder...
Anyway, that's the end of my story.{p}

I suppose the two of them started feeling like Romeo and Juliet.
Of all things, they tried to sneak out in the middle of the night to meet.
But unluckily, they were caught.
You can't imagine how furious both families were.
Each side claimed their child had been led astray by the other, so things kept getting uglier and uglier...{p}

The two of them had become just like the real Romeo and Juliet.
But that wasn't enough to make their love cool.
This time, they decided to try a telephone strategy.
If a parent answered, the call would just get cut off, so they had to be very careful.
They studied each family's routines and worked out the time that seemed safest.{p}

This is what Yaguchi thought.
She wasn't the one in the wrong.
Date was the one who was mistaken.
So if anyone should apologize, it should be Date... that's how she felt.{p}
But as if someone had known that, the phone rang the very instant it turned nine.

Just then, she heard a little giggle from the other end of the line.
As Yaguchi stiffened with a start, the voice spoke to her.{p}

"Date says he can't stand you anymore, you cheater.
He said he doesn't want you calling him, either."
It was a woman's voice she didn't know.
"Who are you★"
"Date's new girlfriend.
Unlike you, I'm not hated by his parents."
The voice laughed scornfully at Yaguchi.{p}

Unable to bear it, Yaguchi slammed down the receiver.
Date, of all people, would never cheat on her over a single misunderstanding.
She told herself that, but her anxiety wouldn't go away.
So the next day, when they met, she lit into him right away.{p}

"Who was that woman yesterday★"
But instead, Date got angry with her.
"What are you talking about★
Don't think you can talk your way out of this.
You're the one who's got a new boyfriend, aren't you☆"{p}

Yaguchi was stunned.
So they decided to calm down and talk it over properly.
And then they discovered something unbelievable.
Someone had been interfering with their calls.
Two people, in fact: a man pretending to be Date, and a woman pretending to be Date's girlfriend.{p}

"What scum.
I swear I'll find them and beat the hell out of them!"
Date was never the kind of person who resorted to violence without good reason.
But he couldn't forgive the people who had tormented his beloved Yaguchi.{p}

"Then I'll call thirty minutes early."
"Eight-thirty, huh?
Got it. I'll be waiting right by the phone the whole time."
They made a pinky promise and went their separate ways.{p}
And that night, at exactly eight-thirty, Yaguchi made the call.

"Hello..."
As Yaguchi spoke, a woman's voice shrieked in her ear.
"You're that Yaguchi girl, aren't you!
Because of you, something terrible has happened to our Mamoru☆"

Mamoru is Date's given name.
While Yaguchi stood there dumbfounded, a different voice came on the line.
"...I'm sorry. My wife is very upset right now.
You're Yaguchi, aren't you?
I'm Mamoru Date's father."
This time it was the calm voice of a middle-aged man.
So the voice before had been his mother.
Yaguchi asked fearfully.{p}

"Um... has something happened to Mamoru?"
"He was late because of club activities... He was hurrying home to make it in time for your call, and on the way he had an accident."

Date, in an accident★
Yaguchi nearly dropped the receiver.
"It seems he's unconscious.
We were just about to leave for the hospital ourselves."
"I-I'll come too!"
Yaguchi had cried out before she knew it.
"I see. Thank you.
Then let's meet somewhere."{p}
Where do you think Date's father told her to meet them?
In front of the school's back gate
At the intersection near her house
Scream, "Stop it already!"

Date's father named the school's back gate.
Apparently it was convenient for getting to the hospital.{p}

So Yaguchi sneaked out of the house.
If she got caught, they would drag her back for sure, no questions asked.
Thinking that, she naturally moved with caution.
Because of that, she was a little late getting to the meeting place.{p}

When she got there, there was no one at the back gate anymore.
She hadn't made it in time.
They must have gone on ahead.
Just as Yaguchi gave up and was about to head home...

Suddenly, a phone began to ring.
It was the ringing of the pay phone, which had no reason to ring at all.
Who could be calling?
Somehow, it seemed as if the bell was ringing just for her.
What should she do?{p}In a situation like this, would you pick up the receiver?
Pick it up
Wait and watch a little longer
Scream, "Stop it already!"

Date's father named the intersection near her house.
I suppose they couldn't spare the time to go the long way around.{p}

Yaguchi sneaked out of the house.
That intersection was a desolate spot where hardly a soul passed by once night fell.{p}

She couldn't go on ahead, either, because she had forgotten to ask the name of the hospital.
As she stood there at a loss, she saw someone walking toward her from the other direction.{p}

Yaguchi took a few steps forward without thinking.
Because it was Date's parents.
But both of them looked terribly pale.
Was Date's condition really that bad?
That's how worried they made Yaguchi.
"Um, how is Date..."
When she spoke to them, his father glared at her.
"Ah... he wants to see you.
Hurry up and go to him."
As he said that, he grabbed Yaguchi's arm.
His grip was so strong that Yaguchi winced.{p}

"Ow!"
But his father paid no attention.
He just kept dragging Yaguchi along.
Something wasn't right.
Thinking that, Yaguchi resisted.
"Please let go of me.
Where is Date?!"{p}

"I told you, we're taking you to see him!"
His mother screamed and pulled a knife from her pocket.{p}

His father tightened his grip on her arm, too.
"Mamoru always studies in his room, but today he wouldn't budge from in front of the phone.
When I asked him why, he said he was waiting for your call!"
His father's face had become like a demon's.
"I told him to go back to his room, but he wouldn't listen.
I lost my temper and hit him, and he fell... and his head... there was blood...!"

"You killed Date★"
Forgetting even her fear, Yaguchi screamed.{p}

"This is your fault!
Going out with you turned Mamoru into a delinquent!
So you die too☆"
The knife came stabbing at her.{p}

Yaguchi desperately dodged it.
And she shouted,
"So you two were also the ones who made those fake calls to break us up★"
"I don't know anything about that!"
Date's mother raised the knife again.{p}

Just then, the beam of a flashlight flooded over the three of them.
"What's going on here★"
It was a police officer on patrol.
She was saved...
It happened just as Yaguchi let out a sigh of relief.{p}

His mother plunged the knife she'd raised into her own stomach.
Whoosh... they say a tremendous spray of blood shot out.
"If Mamoru dies... there's nothing left to live for..."
Murmuring that, Date's mother collapsed, I'm told.{p}

His father was arrested on the spot, of course.
His mother somehow survived, but I hear she's still in the hospital.
I heard this story from Yaguchi herself, after she graduated... but don't you notice something strange?
...That's right. If it wasn't Date's father and mother who made the fake calls, then who on earth was it?
Even though those calls are what tore Date's family apart...
And that's the end of my story.{p}

Oh, that won't do.
Do you really think their strict parents would allow something like that?
What the two of them did was hang up the moment it started ringing, then call right back.
Simple, but reliable, isn't it?{p}

"But... that's... I can't go."
That's what she said.
"What the hell?
You're the one who called me out here.
Are you messing with me★"
On the other end of the line, Date seemed to be getting really angry.
They might end up fighting again.{p}What should she do?
Say she won't go
Correct herself and say she can go
Scream, "Stop it already!"

"I hate sneaking around to meet at night like this.
And besides, I never called you out anywhere, Date."
Yaguchi pleaded desperately.
She must have felt that if she didn't clear up the misunderstanding now, they could never make up.
"...Fine. I get it.
Forget it!"
There was the sound of the receiver being slammed down.
Date had hung up on her.{p}

Yaguchi agonized over it.
Maybe she should go after all... she thought.
But she hadn't asked where Date was waiting.
Yaguchi agonized and agonized, and the night gave way to dawn without her getting a wink of sleep.{p}

In front of the school gate, she spotted Date running toward her.
To her surprise, Date, who should have been angry, came running straight up to her.{p}

"Thank goodness you're okay!"
At Date's words, Yaguchi's eyes went wide.
"Date, weren't you angry?
About the call last night..."
"Right, right, the phone, yeah.
I waited and you never called, and when I tried calling you, the line was busy.
I couldn't get through at all, so I figured that creep was messing with us again."
Date seemed relieved.{p}

"Huh... then what was that call?"
Just as Yaguchi murmured that,
things suddenly got noisy over in the distance.
There were even girls running toward them in tears, and the whole area was thrown into an uproar.{p}

She and Date went back to being close, just like before.
But you know, Yaguchi says she sometimes thinks about it.
What would have happened back then if she'd believed that fake call and gone out?
What if the person on the phone had named the school's back gate as the meeting place...
She says it might have been her who died inside that phone booth.
Maybe she's just overthinking it.
Tell me, what do you think...?
Anyway, that's the end of my story.{p}

Something about this felt wrong.
That must have been what Yaguchi thought.
So she didn't go to the school.
If that call had really been from Date, he would surely be furious.
But her fear was stronger.
A while later, the phone rang again.{p}

When Yaguchi picked up, the voice on the other end said,
"Why... aren't you coming..."
Just like that.

But it didn't sound like Date's voice.
"Who is this?"
Ignoring Yaguchi's question, the voice on the phone kept on saying it, full of resentment.
"Why didn't you come... I was waiting for you..."
Creepy, isn't it?
So Yaguchi tried to put the receiver down.
But she couldn't.
The receiver was stuck to her hand.{p}
When she looked closely, countless tentacles, fine as threads, were growing out of the receiver.

They were wound around her hand.
The needle-sharp tips of the tentacles pricked her fingers.
"Ow!"
Blood slowly welled up.
Then the tentacles all reared up their heads at once, like snakes, as if they were delighted!
And they stabbed into her hand, trying to burrow under her skin.
She tried to get away, but the receiver itself just wouldn't come off her hand.{p}
